newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Nike eases on results.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Nike eases on results.

text.p: Shares in athletic shoe and apparel maker Nike Inc eased before Wednesday's market opening, weighed by quarterly results slightly below analysts' expectations.
Traders said activity was light ahead of the end of the rate-setting Federal Open Market Committee meeting Wednesday and the release of employment figures Thursday.
"I'm not seeing much going on," a trader said.
Nike was trading at 57-1/2, down from a closing price of 58-13/16 Tuesday. The stock had hit 58 in after-hours trade Tuesday.
The Beaverton, Ore., company posted fourth-quarter earnings Tuesday of $0.52 a share, just off a First Call consensus estimate of $0.53.
Pennzoil Co shares were bid at 73, down from a Tuesday close of 75-5/8. The company has rejected a takeover offer from Union Pacific Resources Group Inc.

Ascend Communications Inc shares were at 45-3/4, up from a Tuesday close of 43-3/4. A market source said Merrill Lynch upgraded the stock to intermediate-term accumulate from neutral and the long-term rating stayed accumulate.
